title: [DEFECT] Agents creating loose capsule/scratch directories in repo root instead of .olt/capsules/ or scratch/
content: Observed that Run 33 created a loose directory 33-skill-auditor-auto-dispatch-alongside-orchestrator directly in the repository root containing brainstorming.json and events.jsonl. This violates Repository Root Hygiene (Rule 30, Rule 11, Rule 40). All runtime capsules MUST strictly reside under .olt/capsules/ (or capsules/), and any temporary scripts, scratch payloads, or one-off JSONs MUST strictly reside under gitignored scratch/ or .olt/scratch/. The harness must enforce a mechanical path validation guard rejecting the creation of un-sandboxed root directories.
